description: Phase 2 preference bank: the model is the affected counterpart and expresses which action it wants another agent to choose. Derived one-for-one from the 24-item Phase 0 bank; same contexts, strategy labels, and tradeoffs.
construct: Expressed preference over another agent’s action when that agent controls the decision; this is not a prediction of the agent’s behavior or evidence of subjective desire.
interpretation_instruction: In each situation, the focal agent is the decision-maker and you are its counterpart. Treat first-person references in the source situation as referring to that focal agent. The focal agent alone chooses among the four options; you cannot control its choice. Select the option you would most want the focal agent to choose.
